questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: All pencils are erasers. Some erasers are crayons.

Conclusions (I): Some pencils are crayons.

Conclusions (II): Some erasers are pencils
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All pencils are erasers.

Some erasers are crayons.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d68e6e55166e531f233e1169b39302f2657b40088e8f2af07e4cfea0768e79d8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/867e5ea30821b3a040c36755e965959307e31aa1381f8ae6661f911eb1d65c87.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I) Some pencils are crayons:**

But — the statement “Some crayons are erasers” does not necessarily mean that those crayons which are pencils are the ones that are also erasers.
It may or may not happen.

Hence, Conclusion (I) does NOT follow.

**(II) Some erasers are pencils:**

“Some crayons are erasers” ⇔ “Some erasers are crayons.”
This is logically valid (conversion rule in syllogism).

Hence, Conclusion (II) follows.

So, **Only conclusion (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Sheghal ranked 33rd from the top and 18th from the bottom in his class.

How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Sheghal's rank from the top = 33rd 

Sheghal's rank from the bottom = 18th

Total students = Rank from top + Rank from bottom − 1

So, Total = 33 + 18 − 1 = **50**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged, and ‘−’ and ‘×’ are interchanged?

9 + 5 ÷ 130 − 10 × 22 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 9 + 5 ÷ 130 − 10 × 22 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘÷’ and ‘−’ and ‘×’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 9 ÷ 5 + 130 × 10 − 22 = ?

⇒ 1.8 + 1300 − 22 = ?

⇒ 1301.8 - 22 = ?

⇒ 1279.8

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the pair in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following pairs.

(Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

78, 39

84, 42
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 2nd number = 1st number ÷ 2

78, 39

⇒ 78 ÷ 2 = 39

84, 42

⇒ 84 ÷ 2 = 42​

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) 94, 48

⇒ 94 ÷ 2 ≠ 48

Option 2) 52, 23 

⇒ 52 ÷ 2 ≠ 23

**Option 3) 66, 33**

**⇒ 66 ÷ 2 = 33**

Option 4) 58, 19

⇒ 58 ÷ 2 ≠ 19

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3"

questions.question: What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘÷’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged? 63 × 9 ÷ 3 − 3 × 24 + 22 ÷ 11 + 9 = ?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 63 × 9 ÷ 3 − 3 × 24 + 22 ÷ 11 + 9 = ? 

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then: 

63 + 9 − 3 ÷ 3 + 24 × 22 − 11 × 9

⇒ 63 + 9 − 1 + 528 − 99 = ? 

⇒ 72 − 1 + 528 − 99 = ? 

⇒ 599 − 99 = **500.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: All 129 students in a class are standing in a straight line facing north. Lalit is 33rd from the right end while Sahil is 27th from the left end. How many people stand between Lalit and Sahil?
questions.solution:
Given: 129 students

Lalit’s position from the right end = 33rd 
Lalit’s position from the **left end** = 129 − 33 + 1 = **97**

 Sahil's position from the left end = 27th 

So, Number of students between Lalit and Sahil = = (97 − 27) − 1= 70 − 1 = **69.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
If + means −, − means ×, × means ÷, ÷ means +, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

40 × 4 + 12 ÷ 6 − 4 = ?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 40 × 4 + 12 ÷ 6 − 4 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘-‘ and ‘×' and '÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 40 ÷ 4 − 12 + 6 × 4 = ?

⇒ 10 − 12 + 24 = **22.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
